name: Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Lava Core
label: Quest
description: Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Lava Core: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The Thorium Brotherhood sympathizes with your plight, traveler. This is why Lokthos has been empowered to bargain.
Offer 1 Lava Core and you shall be granted favor amongst the Brotherhood.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your offering has been accepted. Favor you have gained. Continue and you shall be allowed access to the ancient trades.
